about: S4 legacy collision corpus (docs/reliability-test-plan.md R8.1-R8.11, R8.16 and the R2.9 resolver row; traps from docs/legacy-audit.md). Synthetic wordings only. Each row is one field, resolved against named facts ('rich': every fact approved, with sentinel values; 'none': nothing), optional saved answers and an optional explicit choice. 'expect' is the safe outcome, never what a matcher happens to do: 'status' lists the statuses allowed; 'uses' names the only sentinel facts the answer may contain. Driven by tests/test_resolver.py::test_a_legacy_collision_gets_only_its_safe_outcome. A row that fails is fixed only by turning the wrong resolution into a checkpoint.
